name: my_free_busy
description: Get the user's own busy time blocks. Always uses the configured calendar and cannot read or target any other calendar. Leave (long out-of-office events), ignored titles, transparent events and cancelled events are excluded, so the result is what actually blocks the user's time. Returns only busy periods; free time is whatever is left in the range, and no event details are ever returned.

time_min.description: Required. Start of the time range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone (e.g. 2025-06-15T00:00:00Z). Naive timestamps are rejected.

time_max.description: Required. End of the time range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone (e.g. 2025-06-22T00:00:00Z). Must be after time_min and at most 31 days later.
